name: Mutually Assured Progress
canonical_question: Can interaction be structured so that continued mutual progress becomes the stable trajectory?
compact_interpretation: Advantage is not enough. Progress has to transfer through the dynamics.

claims.statement: For mapShare(q,p0,n)=1-q^n(1-p0), if 0 <= q < 1 then mapShare tends to 1.
Strictly increasing drift alone does not force MAP population convergence.
A strict positive MAP fitness advantage induces a contraction q in [0,1).
A mutation-free MAPPopulationOrbit under PersistentMAPAdvantage converges in MAP population share to 1.
